page.notes: Greek word in the paragraph near "Hujus definitionis" is uncertain and marked [?]: it appears to be ἀνατομὴν. Ordinary long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Hyphenated line-end words "in-trinseca", "dis-tinguuntur" etc. are joined as printed-hyphen words. The page ends on "a-" with the word continuing on the next page. The margin note beside "Cognitio autem est duplex" reads only "Cognitio est" as printed, the rest is on the following page. The marginal notes "Cognitio est" and "Scientia est cognitio..." are beside the lines as shown. No catchword or signature is printed. The page number 269 is at the top right and the running head "DE SCIENTIA." is at top centre-left.
